S1.dek: The Texas Advanced Computing Center put a warning at the top of Frontera's user guide. The guide was last updated September 3rd, 2026.
labels: On October 1, 2026, the Frontera queues will be closed permanently.

S2.hook: Seven years, and one last edit.
S2.dek: "After seven years and billions of computing cycles, Frontera will be riding off into decommission sunset."

S3.hook: Frontera is the largest cluster dedicated to open science in the United States

S4.hook: The cable goes somewhere the page does not.
S4.dek: The guide says the file systems stay reachable to move data off. It names no machine the work goes to.
labels: FRONTERA USER GUIDE ONE PROMISE FOR AFTER THE DATE

S5.hook: The money is real. The manual is not finished.
S5.dek: Leadership Class Computing Facility (LCCF) award, Award Abstract #2323116 07/01/2024 to 04/30/2028
labels: A construction award with a start date and an end date. What it does not yet have is a finished guide.

S6.hook: The door is shut and the room is running.

S7.hook: This user guide is in progress
labels: HORIZON USER GUIDE Last update: August 12, 2026
One side lands. The other ends in connectors nobody has plugged in.

S8.dek: The funder's own record and the machine's own page give award 1818253 two different titles. Neither document mentions the other.

S9.hook: Three ways in. The record checked one.
